summary: The amended RFC and plan are internally consistent and cover the requested removal of playback_sequence runtime and generated fields while reserving the retired protobuf names and tags. The design preserves binary unknown-field behavior, calls out ProtoJSON strict-parser rejection, keeps unverified callback clients diagnostic-only, and requires one ordered audio completed marker before the single message-ID playback receipt can authorize completion. No blocking or major challenge findings were identified, and implementation still requires a separate exact-digest confirmation gate for these new bytes.
